items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1962-11-01
items.q: I know the man, Moneta, you see? Yeah. From coming out there, my home. See, I never forgot him.

ctx.x: Yeah, yeah, yeah. So, so he said, so we wouldn't, we wouldn't take no job. We just rehearsal. So after we, the first job we got, we played for some, oh, Beville Garden, on Beville Street. It rained all day and all night. And then the first job we played for White. That's in, uh, in the Algae area. In the Algae area, right in the Algae, up the Algae, right up the Algae area. Yeah, I know where they are. Yeah. So, all right. And we played, so after that, we, after we, we played there. Well, finally, well, we keep…
